name: ai-account-switcher-resume
description: Resumes Codex and agy integrated-terminal sessions after AI Account Switcher changes profiles.

aiAccountSwitcherResume.capacityRetry.description: Retry confirmed model-capacity failures. Automatic sends continue only to observed background Codex terminals with a fresh empty prompt and an eligible goal (or no goal). Other sessions offer Copy continue. Five automatic attempts per hour per session; never spends resets or switches accounts.

aiAccountSwitcherResume.cleanupStaleGoal.description: Dismiss an observed goal-resume dialog in a session resumed by this extension when fresh checks confirm its goal was cleared or the same goal completed. Valid paused goals and other prompts are left alone.

aiAccountSwitcherResume.enabled.description: Capture and resume Codex and agy commands when AI Account Switcher changes profiles.

aiAccountSwitcherResume.continueInterrup.description: After a profile switch, continue an exact linked Codex session only if its goal was active or usage-limited before capture. Never changes goal budgets. Requires a CLI with goal support; unknown sessions must be linked using the command palette.

commands.title: AI Account Switcher: Link Codex Session

scripts.package: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && node scripts/package.mjs
